description: It’s not a stretch to say that 007 First Light is perhaps the best Bond game ever made, even as you consider the far-reaching influence and legacy of GoldenEye 007 on the Nintendo 64. It’s also one of the better narrative-driven linear action-adventure games in the mould of Uncharted — there aren’t that many of those now.
title: 007 First Light Review: Licence to Thrill

description: Samsung's upcoming foldable smartphones and smartwatches have reportedly appeared in FCC certification listings in the US. According to a recent report, the filings are linked to the Galaxy Z Flip 8, Galaxy Z Fold 8 Ultra, Galaxy Watch 9 series, and Galaxy Watch Ultra 2. The certifications suggest the devices are moving closer to launch. The rumoured Galaxy Z Fold 8 Wide and Galaxy Watch 9 Classic have not yet surfaced in FCC records. Samsung is expected to unveil its new hardware at a Galaxy Unpacked event in July.
title: Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 8 Ultra, Z Flip 8, Watch 9 Reportedly Listed on US FCC Weeks Ahead of Anticipated Debut

description: A new set of images of dummy units leaked online offering a look at the iPhone Ultra. The renders suggest a departure from the design language seen on existing foldable smartphones. It appears to have a wider outer screen. The renders show the iPhone Ultra in a white colour option. The inner screen has a selfie camera in the top-left corner, and the dual rear cameras are arranged horizontally. The rear camera island has an LED flash and a microphone.
title: iPhone Ultra Spotted Again via Leaked Dummy Images That Offer a Better Look at the Foldable's Design

description: Samsung Galaxy S27 series is expected to use display panels from BOE. Now, Samsung Electronics President Roh Tae-moon is reportedly set to visit BOE later this month. This would mark the first time the head of Samsung Electronics' smartphone and TV businesses has met with BOE. It suggests that BOE is likely to be selected to supply displays for the standard Galaxy S27.
title: Samsung's TM Roh Reportedly Plans to Visit BOE in June Amid Galaxy S27 OLED Supply Talks

description: Xiaomi's upcoming XRing O3 chipset has surfaced in new leaks. The processor is reportedly being developed on TSMC's 3nm process and could offer improved efficiency and performance compared to the XRing O1. Leaks also point to a redesigned CPU architecture featuring Prime, Titanium, and Little cores, with a peak clock speed of 4.05GHz. The XRing O3 could debut as early as August and may be used in more Xiaomi devices, including the rumoured Mix Fold 5.
title: Xiaomi's Xring O3 Chip Could Use TSMC's 3nm Process, Deliver Major Efficiency Gains Over Predecessor

description: Many of us juggle more than one phone number. One is usually reserved for work, while another is for personal use, keeping both aspects of our lives separate. Managing multiple numbers has been easy for years thanks to features like dual-SIM and eSIM support. However, running two separate WhatsApp accounts on a single iPhone has always been an absolute headache. Thankfully, that's finally changing. WhatsApp now officially supports dual accounts on one iPhone.
title: How to Create and Remove Multiple Accounts on WhatsApp for iPhone: A Step-by-Step Guide

description: HMD C2 and HMD C2P are said to launch soon. As we wait for the formal launch, a leak has suggested the possible specifications, design renders, and European pricing of the HMD C2 series. They are said to come with 6.78-inch AMOLED displays and 6,000mAh batteries. The series is likely to run on Snapdragon 4 Gen 4 processors. The HMD C2 is said to feature a 50-megapixel primary sensor, while the HMD C2P could carry a 64-megapixel primary sensor.
title: HMD C2, HMD C2P Price and Design Leak Online; Tipped to Arrive With 6,000mAh Batteries, 6.78-Inch Displays

description: Huawei will launch the FreeBuds 7i and FreeBuds SE 4 in India on June 18. Both true wireless earphones will be available via Flipkart and the RTC India website. The FreeBuds 7i features 28dB ANC, spatial audio, head tracking, and up to 35 hours of battery life. The FreeBuds SE 4 offers up to 24dB ANC and up to 50 hours of total playback. Flipkart listings reveal MRPs of Rs. 13,999 for the FreeBuds 7i and Rs. 7,999 for the FreeBuds SE 4.
title: Huawei FreeBuds 7i, FreeBuds SE 4 India Launch Date Announced; Colour Options, Key Features Revealed

description: The UK is banning social media for children under 16, the UK Prime Minister Keir Starmer announced in his speech from 10 Downing Street on Monday. He cited mental health concerns, addiction, and bullying as a few of the reasons behind the decision and claims that the decision will give children their “childhoods back". According to a BBC report, social media platforms like Snapchat, TikTok, YouTube, Instagram, Facebook, and the microblogging platform X will be part of the ban, keeping instant messaging services like WhatsApp and Signal out of the list.
title: UK to Follow in Australia’s Footsteps With Social Media Ban for Children Under 16

description: Japanese crypto exchange Bitbank has warned users that transactions linked to prediction market platforms such as Polymarket could result in account restrictions. The move comes amid ongoing regulatory uncertainty surrounding prediction markets in Japan.
title: Japanese Crypto Exchange Bitbank Limits Polymarket-Related Fund Transfers

description: WhatsApp is reportedly rolling out group voice and video calling support on WhatsApp Web for selected beta testers. The feature allows users to start group calls directly from a browser and supports up to 32 participants. Users can choose specific participants, create call links, enable waiting rooms, and share their screens during video calls. Group calls remain protected by end-to-end encryption. The update builds on WhatsApp's web calling feature introduced earlier this year and is expected to reach more beta users in the coming weeks.
title: WhatsApp Reportedly Begins Testing Group Voice and Video Calls for WhatsApp Web Users

description: Samsung Galaxy Z Flip 8 could run on either the Exynos 2600 or Qualcomm's Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 for Galaxy. It could launch with Samsung's in-house Exynos chipset in South Korea and select European markets, while markets like Japan and several other global markets are tipped to get the variant with the Snapdragon chipset. The launch of new foldables is expected to take place on July 22 in London.
title: Samsung Galaxy Z Flip 8 Tipped to Launch With Qualcomm or Exynos Chipsets Based on Markets

description: Pova 8 Pro 5G has been spotted on the list of supported devices on the Google Play Console with the model number TECNO-LK7. The listing suggests that the smartphone maker could be planning to launch the handset soon. On top of this, the key specifications and features of the rumoured purported Pova 8 series phone have surfaced online. The handset is said to be powered by an octa core MediaTek MT6878 chipset, delivering a peak clock of 2.5GHz, which could be the Dimensity 7300 SoC. Moreover, it is expected to sport a 1,208 x 2,644 pixels resolution display.
title: Pova 8 Pro 5G Launch Seems Imminent as Handset Appears on Google Play Console; Key Specifications Leaked

description: Samsung's rumoured Wide Fold foldable smartphone could use a 60-micrometre Ultra Thin Glass layer, according to a recent report. The thicker UTG is expected to improve crease visibility and durability compared to the 45-micrometre layer reportedly used on the Galaxy Z Fold 8. The report also claims Samsung is preparing three foldable smartphones this year, including the Galaxy Z Flip 8, Galaxy Z Fold 8, and Wide Fold. The company may later expand the thicker UTG technology to future Fold models.
title: Samsung Wide Fold Leak Hints at Upgrades to Ultra Thin Glass for Better Crease Control

description: In recent months, several smartphone brands have increased the prices of their smartphones. While OEMs have refrained from officially commenting on the hikes, it is largely attributed to the global shortage of memory components due to demand for enterprise-focused data centres. Vivo has allegedly become the latest brand to revise its pricing for several handsets, such as the Vivo V70 and Vivo V70 Elite. It is said to affect mid-range models too, including the Vivo Y-series.
title: Vivo V70, Vivo V70 Elite Price In India Reportedly Hiked; Vivo Y-Series Pricing Also Revised

description: Oppo Find X10 Pro is said to come with a 1/1.3-inch 200-megapixel sensor. It could run on a 2nm MediaTek Dimensity chipset and a 6.78-inch LTPO display with 1.5K resolution. It is said to feature a 3D ultrasonic fingerprint sensor and an IP68 + IP69-rated build for dust and water resistance. The Oppo Find X10 Pro is said to go official in late 2026 alongside the Oppo Find X10 and Find X10 Pro Max.
title: Oppo Find X10 Pro Leak Hints at Advanced Dual 200-Megapixel Camera Setup

description: Vivo X Fold 6 will be launched in China soon with a quad rear camera setup, headlined by a 200-megapixel main shooter, featuring a 1/1.4-inch sensor from Blueprint and Samsung, an f/1.68 aperture, and OIS. Moreover, it will carry a 50-megapixel rear camera with 23mm to 100mm equivalent focal lengths and a Sony LYT-602 periscope telephoto sensor. The phone will also support Vivo’s Zeiss G2 teleconverter lens. The Vivo X Fold 6 will be equipped with a Blueprint Image Chip V3+, too. The foldable will sport an 8.02-inch foldable screen on the inside with Samsung M14 luminescent material, delivering up to 5,000 nits of peak brightness.
title: Vivo X Fold 6 Confirmed to Launch With a 200-Megapixel Rear Camera, 5,000-Nit Foldable Screen

description: Microsoft is rolling out a new feature for Microsoft Teams that can automatically detect when employees are in the office. The company says that the Workplace Check-In feature works in tandem with Microsoft Places to detect the user’s connection to a corporate Wi-Fi network. The capability, first spotted on Microsoft's roadmap last year, can automatically update a user's workplace location when they connect to approved office networks.
title: Microsoft Teams Update Adds Workplace Check-In Feature That Detects Office Presence Using Wi-Fi

description: Apple reportedly held back three iOS 27 features from the WWDC 2026 showcase. The iOS 27 could bring a Modular face for the Apple Watch, an Extensions feature, and a customisable Camera app. They are likely to be disclosed in September. The customisable camera app could arrive alongside the launch of the iPhone 18 Pro. The Extension feature could offer support for additional third-party chatbots within Siri.
title: Apple Said to Be Working on Three Additional iOS 27 Features It Didn't Reveal at WWDC 2026

description: Honor X70 Pro Max has been silently launched in China. The handset arrives as the latest addition to the X70 lineup, which already comprises the standard Honor X70. The handset sports a 6.79-inch AMOLED screen with up to 6,000 nits peak brightness. It is powered by the Snapdragon 6 Gen 4 Enhanced Edition SoC, coupled with 8GB of RAM. The Honor X70 Pro Max runs on Android 16-based MagicOS 10.0 and packs an 8,560mAh battery.
title: Honor X70 Pro Max Launched in China With Snapdragon 6 Gen 4 Enhanced Edition SoC: Price, Specifications

description: A new GSMA database listing has revealed a Xiaomi smartphone carrying the codename "madrid", which is believed to belong to the upcoming Xiaomi 18 series. The entry includes model numbers linked to China, India, global, and Japan variants, suggesting a broad market rollout. The report also points to a possible November 2026 launch window based on Xiaomi's model-number patterns. Previous leaks indicate the lineup could feature Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 chips, LPDDR6 RAM, and compact 6.3-inch to 6.4-inch displays.
title: Xiaomi 18 Reportedly Listed in GSMA Database With Codename 'Madrid' Ahead of Anticipated Launch

description: OnePlus N6 will be launched in India on June 30 at 12 pm IST, the smartphone maker announced on Monday. The new handset is set to debut in the country as the first OnePlus N series phone, which is expected to be positioned as the tech firm’s new entry-level offering. As part of the launch date announcement, the company has also revealed the design of the upcoming smartphone. The OnePlus N6 is shown to feature a square-shaped rear camera module, housing a dual camera setup and an LED flash. The handset will go on sale in the country via Amazon in at least two colour options.
title: OnePlus N6 India Launch Date Revealed Along With Price Range and Design

description: Amazon Smartchoice Days sale began on June 11 and is set to conclude on June 18. Before the sale ends, you can purchase laptops and tablets from brands like Samsung, Lenovo, Xiaomi, Acer, Asus, and HP at relatively low prices, allowing you to maximise your savings. If you are an Amazon Prime member, you can get an additional 5 percent discount on your purchase. During the sale event, you can get the Acer Aspire One with an Intel Core Celeron N4500 processor at a discounted price of Rs. 35,990, instead of its listed price of Rs. 55,999.
title: Amazon Smartchoice Days Sale Brings Discounts on Asus Vivobook S16, Samsung Galaxy Tab S10 Lite and More Devices

description: Bitcoin climbed above $65,000 after a US-Iran peace deal improved investor sentiment and ended a period of geopolitical uncertainty. Analysts said renewed ETF inflows and easing energy market concerns supported the recovery, though traders remain focused on the upcoming Federal Reserve meeting.
title: Bitcoin Climbs Above $65,800 as US-Iran Peace Deal Boosts Risk Appetite

description: Activision has confirmed early access for the Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 campaign. Players who pre-order the game on PC, PS5, Xbox Series S/X, and Nintendo Switch 2 will get one-week campaign early access, starting October 16. Modern Warfare 4 launches on October 23.
title: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 Campaign Will Have One-Week Early Access, Activision Confirms

description: Microsoft is reportedly weighing its options for restructuring the Xbox business amidst declining revenue and hardware sales. The company is said to be considering spinning off the gaming division or restructuring it as a wholly owned subsidiary. Xbox is reportedly also planning to invest more into its biggest franchises like Halo, Fallout, and The Elder Scrolls.
title: Microsoft Reportedly Considering Spinning Off Xbox, Accelerating Development of Fallout, The Elder Scrolls

description: Honor X80 Pro Max will be launched in China on June 22 at 7 pm local time (4:30 pm IST). Along with the launch date, the tech firm has also confirmed that the new Honor X80 Pro Max will be equipped with an 11,000mAh battery. The new Honor X80 series smartphone will also ship with support for 90W wired fast charging and 27W wired reverse charging. On top of this, the Honor X80 Pro Max is confirmed to go on sale in China in four colour options, namely Lightning Red, Moonlight White, Mystic Black, and Vibrant Orange (translated from Chinese).
title: Honor X80 Pro Max Launch Date Announced; Confirmed to Arrive With an 11,000mAh Battery

description: The purported iQOO Neo 11S has appeared on Geekbench, revealing several key specifications ahead of launch. A listing linked to the Vivo V2545A model number suggests the handset could feature MediaTek's upcoming Dimensity 9500 chipset, 16GB of RAM, Android 16, and a Mali-G1-Ultra MC12 GPU. The benchmark entry shows single-core and multi-core scores of 3,395 and 10,312, respectively. Earlier certification records also indicate support for 100W wired fast charging.
title: iQOO Neo 11S Appears on Geekbench With MediaTek Dimensity 9500, 16GB RAM

description: In the latest edition of the Power On newsletter, Mark Gurman hinted that adoption of Siri AI could lead Apple to introduce fees for advanced features. Apple is still in the early stages of convincing customers that its AI technology is worth using, let alone worth paying for. The Siri and Image Playground features have significant server resources and high costs. Based on this, Gurman believes that more conversational, world knowledge and generative AI features will eventually get rate-limited and then require a fee.
title: Apple Could Introduce a Subscription for Advanced Siri AI Features: Mark Gurman

description: The Oppo Reno 16 series appears to be inching closer to its launch. In recent weeks, the Indian and global variant standard Reno 16 has been sighted on a benchmarking site, hinting towards its debut in the aforementioned regions. Now, the purported global version of the Reno 16 Pro has appeared on the benchmarking platform as well. The listing reveals key details about the handset, including its chipset, RAM configuration, and operating system.
title: Oppo Reno 16 Pro Global Variant Listed on Geekbench With Dimensity 8500 Chip, Android 16

description: Apple held its Worldwide Developers Conference (WWDC) 2026 last week, where it previewed its upcoming operating system update for devices like the iPhone, iPad, and Mac. In subsequent post-keynote sessions, the Cupertino-based tech giant also revealed that the updates would mark the end of the road for several older products. Apple is dropping support for a total of 16 devices across four product categories with the introduction of iPadOS 27, watchOS 27, macOS 27 Golden Gate, and tvOS 27.
title: Apple to End Software Support for 16 iPad, Mac, Apple Watch and Apple TV Models With Latest Updates
